'''Witches and Monsters''' is a featurette included in the Blu-ray and DVD release of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Three|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Three]]. It covers the development of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|season three]] episodes "[[Nightsisters (episode)|Nightsisters]]," "[[Monster]]" and "[[Witches of the Mist]]."

The featurette also explores [[Katie Lucas]]' involvement as a writer in the series, along with the creation and development of [[Asajj Ventress]], the [[Nightsisters]], [[Talzin|Mother Talzin]], [[Dathomir]], and [[Savage Opress]].
